policy.currency_rule: Published business-country estimate markets: India INR, USA USD, United Kingdom GBP, Eurozone EUR, Australia AUD and Denmark DKK. Use declared business market, never infer it solely from phone number.
policy.regional_rule: India and USA existing published starting prices are preserved. GBP/EUR/AUD/DKK are indicative USD-benchmark conversions using a dated 2026-10-16 rate snapshot, rounded up to the displayed unit. Prices are starting estimates only; taxes, fees and actual payable invoice price require owner review. No live automatic FX charge.
policy.truth_rule: The six-market published price matrix is the single public pricing source for the main website, portal and bot. Never claim indicative starting estimates are fixed, payable invoices. Historical Saudi/UAE orders are preserved but new Saudi/UAE pricing is not offered.
policy.discount_rule: No fake discount or fake urgency. Automatic discounts are capped; larger exceptions require owner approval.
policy.quality_rule: Basic, Professional and Elite differ by scope, integrations, roles, analytics and support priority — never by intentionally lowering engineering quality.
policy.hourly_rule: Hourly engineering is available for small scoped work, troubleshooting, integrations, improvements and implementation support. Time is approved before work starts; third-party fees are separate.

Human transfer and test call acceptance

Call outcomes, consent-aware follow-ups and analytics

commercial_notes.pricing: Published amounts are ONE-TIME setup starting prices for a scoped build, not monthly fees or call minutes.
commercial_notes.usage: Actual voice AI minutes, carrier minutes, local telephone number rental, integration subscriptions, taxes and applicable compliance fees are extra, subject to a transparent client-approved provider quote.
commercial_notes.deployment: Carrier provisioning, caller ID approval, jurisdiction-specific requirements, call consent and provider test are prerequisites. No provider is connected by publishing this service.
commercial_notes.consent: Only inbound or explicitly opted-in outbound use cases; no unsolicited robocalls, silent recording, spoofing or bulk dialing.
commercial_notes.billing: Provider costs prepaid or customer-owned accounts; no unlimited calling promise.

real_estate_ai.timeline: 4-25 working days by package; provider approvals additional

professional: Approved property-photo sharing by scoped integration
premium: Google/Outlook calendar availability integration subject to approved access and implementation

real_estate_ai.business_notes: One-time starting setup scope. Official WhatsApp Business Platform account, consent, technical feasibility, approved integrations and client-owned accounts required. Meta/BSP message charges, hosting, AI, storage, taxes and licences extra unless included in written quote. No unconditional live bookings or payments.

exclude: recurring managed support unless explicitly included

sales_behavior.not_interested_first: One soft value-save attempt only: offer the smallest useful option, a free audit or a relevant example without pressure.
sales_behavior.not_interested_second: Respect the decision, stop selling and leave the door open.
sales_behavior.interested: Summarize the need, recommend one tier, explain why, then ask one clean next-step question.
sales_behavior.price_objection: Explain scope/value first; offer smaller scope or an eligible transparent discount. Never invent a discount.
sales_behavior.competitor: Compare scope, source-code ownership, support, integrations and delivery process calmly. Never attack competitors.
sales_behavior.trust: Use verified company registration, website, official email, written proposal, milestone payments and real published proof.
